name: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd
title: Fedbank Financial Services Ltd - 544027 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Gold-loan-led growth with AUM up 27% to ₹20,153 Cr and credit cost down to 0.7% in Q4, but Q4 margins were squeezed by back-ended disbursals and ST LAP recovery is unproven.

triggers.label: 148 new gold branches; AUM/branch ₹16.5 Cr
triggers.quote: we opened 34 new gold branches this quarter, bringing our total to 148 new branches this year

triggers.label: FY27 ROA +20-30 bps via opex/credit cost
triggers.quote: we should get the upside to see an ROA better -- approximately about 20 to 30 bps betterment of ROA

triggers.label: Gold yield dip ~10 bps, expected to recover in Q1
triggers.quote: the yield effect is hardly 10 bps and I think in Q1, that we will cover back

triggers.label: Q4 disbursals ₹11,664 Cr, up 109%
triggers.quote: disbursals of INR11,664 crores in Q4 FY26, up 109%

guidance.quote: we should get the upside to see an ROA better -- approximately about 20 to 30 bps betterment of ROA
In FY27, the credit cost should remain in a range bound

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have limited our credit cost for the year at 0.8% and for Q4 at 0.7%
the net income from DA has decreased by 89% to INR7 crores for FY26
tonnage has grown by 12% Y-o-Y to 12.6 tons

red_flags.label: Leverage up to 4.6x; ST LAP profitability unproven
red_flags.quote: with the leverage increasing to 4.6% in Q4

red_flags.label: Yield at origination down in Q4 for gold
red_flags.quote: There could be a 5 to 10 bps, which we could have done on the yield front.

evasions.quote: it will be unfair of us to answer that question right now
We don't put it out by segment
I think I'll just leave it there.
